records.note: u32 LE = 3602. Same value as the file container header (bytes 0-3), i.e. the save format revision tag.
u16 length prefix (5) + ASCII. Matches the reported Dwarf Fortress version 53.16 exactly.

Four u16-length-prefixed ASCII labels appearing in sequence, each followed by two u32 values. They are the standard DF creature_race id labels (DWARF=0). They are vocabulary, NOT a roster of this save's inhabitants.

records.basis: These two single-word df::language_name fields sit in the cur_savegame block at the tail of world.sav, whose only name-bearing fields are fortress_name and world_name. 'Give Me the Fortress' matches DF's fortress-name convention; 'A Record of the Forest' matches its world-name convention. Order was NOT verified against the df-structures layout.
records.do_not: Do not treat as narrative fact until confirmed in-game.

records.field: u32 values preceding the two name fields
records.note: Sequential small integers immediately preceding each name. Their semantic (index? year? id?) could not be determined with confidence. NOT interpreted as dates.
